segments.en: Yeah.
Like when I was growing up, my dad would take out the garbage and that was it.
segments.zh: 就像我长大的时候，我爸爸会把垃圾倒掉，就是这样。

segments.en: My mom had to do everything else.
segments.zh: 我妈妈必须做其他一切。

segments.en: But now I think it's becoming a lot more common in especially in North America for the household chores to be divided between the man and the wife equally.
segments.zh: 但现在我认为，在北美地区，家务家的家务平等地分开，这变得越来越普遍。

segments.en: Yeah, I think it's fair.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这是公平的。

segments.en: Me too.
Yeah.
You'd make a good husband, Marco.
segments.zh: 你会成为一个好丈夫，马可。

segments.en: That's what they say, but they haven't married me yet.
segments.zh: 他们是这么说的，但他们还没有嫁给我。

segments.en: Okay. All right.
Well, we're out of time, folks.
segments.zh: 好吧，伙计们，我们已经没有时间了。

segments.en: Be sure to log on to our community website and you can leave all your comments and maybe other house husbands out there can give us their feedback on what they think about this.
segments.zh: 请务必登录我们的社区网站，您可以留下您的所有评论，也许其他家庭丈夫可以就他们对此的看法向我们提供反馈。

segments.en: Yeah. So check us out at EnglishPod.com and thanks for listening today, everyone.
segments.zh: 是的。 因此，请访问 englishpod.com 查看我们，感谢大家今天的收听。

segments.en: Until next time, this is Marco and Erika saying, bye.
segments.zh: 直到下一次，这是 Marco 和 Erika 说，再见。

segments.en: Goodbye.
